raises.label: Two results bundled
raises.text: Criteria S1.3, S2.3, S2.5, S4.6, S4.8, S5.4, S6.4 and S8.1 each hold two results or cases. Split each into one criterion per result.
raises.evidence: S4.6: `every label ... exists, and labels already there are unchanged`; S2.3: `forged, expired or for another repo`.

raises.label: S2.4 wrong key
raises.text: S2.4 says the service returns a key for the run's repo. Filing upstream needs a key for Dokima's own repo, as the owner describes. Reword S2.4 to that.
raises.evidence: Comment 6254370728: #872 mints a key `for the upstream owner`; S2.4 says `a key for that repo`.

raises.label: No criterion: docs
raises.text: The owner lists docs as part of this work, and no criterion carries them. Add one: the install guide describes the one-click install, keeping self-made App steps as fallback.
raises.evidence: Comment 6254370728: `the bug-report checkbox and docs`. `docs/wiki/Installing.md` still says create your own App.

raises.label: S1.1 misses a file
raises.text: S1.1 changes the App's permissions, but the permission list also lives in the manifest, and an older test pins administration to read. Add that file to S1.1.
raises.evidence: `dokima/manifest.py:54` PERMISSIONS; `tests/test_manifest.py:468` (282.4) asserts administration read, equal to `dokima/app.json`.
